Amplify the Good

Short-form sermon clips for social media, from United Church on the Green and the Young Prophets Collective in New Haven.

A pipeline pulls sermon captions, picks out quotable moments and cuts preview clips; each morning I approve or reject five from my phone, and the approved ones get captioned and posted.
